name: setup-manaflow-ai-lamina-slate-look
description: A whole cmux look built only from public surfaces: Lamina Slate, a layered, translucent desktop look, neutral, flatter and denser, on solid layers with no glass. Theme files for color, glass, layers and proportions (Lamina Slate, dark, the default; Lamina Slate Light), settings for how panes separate, a threads sidebar grouped by folder and the chat's column, a stylesheet of cmux.agentPane.style/1 tokens for 8 point cards and one-point strokes in the chat, and --cmux-md-* tokens that draw the Markdown viewer the same way. Remove it and everything you had comes back.

files.themes/lamina-slate-light.json:
// Lamina Slate: a layered, translucent desktop look (neutral, flatter and denser, light). Pane and control corners 4 and 8,
// one-point strokes, no reveal effects, an accent mark on the selected row. Every key is a look key.
{
  "name": "Lamina Slate Light",
  "description": "A layered, translucent desktop look: neutral, flatter and denser, light.",

  // Palette: layer color, ink, selection, accent.
  "appearance.theme": "Builtin Light",
  "colors": {"background": "#ffffff", "foreground": "#1d1e21", "selection": "#d3e1f2", "accent": "#3d6fa5"},
  "appearance.appTheme": "followTerminal",
  "appearance.accent": "theme",
  "appearance.highlightColor": "#d3e1f2",

  // Glass: how much of the desktop shows through the layers.
  "appearance.background": "none",
  "appearance.backgroundBlur": "none",
  "appearance.backgroundOpacity": 1,
  "appearance.glassTransparency": 0.0,
  "appearance.wallpaperTint": true,
  "appearance.inactiveWindowDim": 0.03,

  // Chrome: cards with a one-point stroke, a subtle tone in the title area.
  "appearance.chromeStyle": "flat-sidebar-line",
  "appearance.borders": "default",
  "appearance.titleAreaTone": "oneColor",
  "appearance.titleAreaContrast": 0.6,
  "appearance.cornerFlush": "flush-tight",
  "appearance.focusIndicator": "tabs",
  "focus.inactiveTabStyle": "quiet",

  // Layers: sidebar and docks lowest, title and tabs next, content on top.
  "appearance.sidebarSurface": "separate",
  "appearance.surfaces.sidebar.color": "#f0f1f3",
  "appearance.surfaces.sidebar.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.tabBar.color": "#f0f1f3",
  "appearance.surfaces.tabBar.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.color": "#ffffff",
  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.terminal.color": "#ffffff",
  "appearance.surfaces.terminal.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.newTabPage.color": "#ffffff",
  "appearance.surfaces.newTabPage.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.home.color": "#ffffff",
  "appearance.surfaces.home.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.settings.color": "#ffffff",
  "appearance.surfaces.settings.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.internalPage.color": "#ffffff",
  "appearance.surfaces.internalPage.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.markdown.color": "#ffffff",
  "appearance.surfaces.markdown.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.diff.color": "#ffffff",
  "appearance.surfaces.diff.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.editor.color": "#ffffff",
  "appearance.surfaces.editor.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.browserChrome.color": "#f0f1f3",
  "appearance.surfaces.browserChrome.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.docks.color": "#f0f1f3",
  "appearance.surfaces.docks.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.splitDivider.color": "#dcdee2",
  "appearance.surfaces.splitDivider.opacity": 1,

  // Panes: 8 point corners, one-point stroke.
  "layout.paneCornerRadius": 8,
  "layout.paneBorderWidth": 1,
  "layout.cornerPadding": 2,

  // Sidebar: compact rows, a one-point edge, the accent on the selected row.
  "sidebar.border": true,
  "sidebar.borderWidth": 1,
  "sidebar.sectionLook": "lines",
  "sidebar.density": "compact",
  "sidebar.groupHeader.background": "solid",

  // Density and metrics.
  "appearance.density": "ultraCompact",
  "appearance.metrics.sidebarRowHeight": 24,
  "appearance.metrics.titlebarHeight": 28,
  "appearance.metrics.tabStripHeight": 26,
  "appearance.metrics.tabFontSize": 12,
  "appearance.metrics.chromeFontSize": 12,
  "appearance.metrics.dividerThickness": 1,
  "appearance.fontSmoothing": "auto",

  // Type: the system face in the chat, a slightly smaller code scale.
  "agentPane.display.font.preset": "system",
  "agentPane.display.font.ui": "system-ui",
  "agentPane.display.font.size": 13,
  "agentPane.display.font.lineHeight": 1.45,
  "agentPane.display.code.scale": 0.9,

  // Status: work in progress shows as a thin ring in the accent.
  "appearance.statusIndicator.style": "dot",
  "appearance.statusIndicator.size": 1,
  "appearance.statusIndicator.thickness": 1.5,
  "appearance.statusIndicator.color": "#3d6fa5",

  // Motion: short color changes, nothing slides in.
  "appearance.colorTransition.duration": 120,
  "appearance.colorTransition.curve": "easeOut"
}
